text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hup-to-it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Heave... ho...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tracen Academy grounds, carrot farm—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki, Tamamo Cross, and Inari One 
were taking part in the Academy's 
volunteer farm work.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Tending to a carrot patch takes 
quite a bit of strength, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. It would be my 
pleasure to help everyone, and it will 
serve as great training as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I wonder how 
Tamamo-san and Inari-san are doing. I hope 
there's something we can do to help..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, they should be 
working out in that field over there—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Sweating it out in the fields is 
what makes our daily rice taste so good! 
How about it, Tama, you worn out yet?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, I'm doing great as you can 
see! It's like flippin' a whole hot plate 
full of takoyaki!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Well aren't you talking quite the dashing 
talk! Get outta here with that! How 'bout 
we just settle this with a match?"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Sounds fun, let's do it! Yaeno, don't just 
stand there watchin', come on!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
The 1st Cultivation Stakes... is 
officially underway!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: No, I think I'll pass.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Aw, don't be such a spoilsport. Adding a 
little fun can actually make things go a 
whole lot smoother, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"This is merely to assist the academy; we 
must not forget our primary duty."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Cultivating the land is akin to 
spiritual training.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What was that?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Work that seems rough at first glance, yet 
is packed with delicate technique. At 
times powerfully confronting nature, at 
times gently nurturing the plants.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Watching the crops slowly grow, eventually 
growing along with them—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
You must not simply let your emotions take 
over and devote yourself blindly.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I see! When you put it that way, I 
can't help feeling like maybe that's 
really how it is!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"True, hearin' it from someone as calm and 
composed as Yaeno really makes it 
convincin'..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Inari! Let's follow Yaeno's lead 
and treat this job as part of our 
training!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Loud and clear, Tama! Tilling the soil is 
part of training... Heheh, ya got me 
there!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew...! We've tilled quite a bit, haven't 
we?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're right, let's take a quick breather. 
Can't just throw ourselves blindly into 
the work; we gotta remember the ways of 
farming!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Now then, Yaeno, time for a break—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaa~~~~h!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Wh-What in blazes is going on?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Focus the mind! Absolute concentration! 
For the sake of my own growth, seii! Teii!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crunch! Crunch! Crunch! Crunch!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who said it, yet you're the 
most swept up in your emotions, aren't 
you?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
T-This kinda looks like training too, I 
guess, but would stoppin' 'em be the 
kinder move...?
choice_data_list: Go, Yaeno, keep up this momentum!
What matters in training is keeping at it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Ossu! Yaeno Muteki shall strive with all 
her might!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaa~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Y-Ya sure about that!? Is that seriously 
okay!?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
N-No... but thanks to that, the field is 
getting plowed at lightning speed...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Yaeno Muteki finished tilling 
the field at a ferocious speed. The work 
was done quickly, but—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Ossu! That was excellent training!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Well, as long as she's satisfied, let's 
call it good!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Exactly right! Once you've begun your 
training, you cannot simply abandon it 
halfway through!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Focus! Maintain! Focus! Maintain!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
S-Such precision...! I thought she was 
just going with the flow, but lookin' 
closely, her work is crazy meticulous!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Man, we can't let ourselves lose either! 
Let's do this, Tama!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, the three earnestly continued 
tilling the field—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the field was tidied up so 
beautifully that Chairwoman Akikawa, who 
manages the plots, gave high praise!
